name: Repository Pattern
description: Data access layer separating business logic from ORM
template_code:
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

class BaseRepository(ABC):
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self._session = session

class ItemRepository(BaseRepository):
    async def get_by_id(self, item_id: str):
        return await self._session.get(Item, item_id)

    async def list_all(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):
        result = await self._session.execute(
            select(Item).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def add(self, item: Item) -> Item:
        self._session.add(item)
        await self._session.commit()
        await self._session.refresh(item)
        return item

    async def delete(self, item: Item) -> None:
        await self._session.delete(item)
        await self._session.commit()
best_practices: Keep repositories focused on a single entity
Do not leak ORM session outside repository
